videos.title: #1 Principles of Islamic Finance - ACCA / CPA / SFM -By Saheb Academy
videos.summary: Conventional banking shifts all financial risk onto the borrower, but Islamic finance fundamentally flips the script by requiring true equity partnerships, tangible asset backing, and shared profit and loss. By unpacking foundational Sharia principles—from why interest is banned as exploitative to why speculative derivatives are barred—this breakdown reveals how a multi-trillion-dollar ethical system creates wealth without predatory debt traps. If you are an accounting student or simply curious about an alternative to modern debt-fueled banking, this straightforward guide will change how you view finance forever.

timestamps.topic: Why Interest (Riba) Is Prohibited and Exploitative
Prohibitions on Speculation (Maisir), Derivatives, and Excessive Uncertainty (Gharar)
Equitable Risk-Sharing and Partnership-Based Wealth Creation

videos.title: 10 Timeless Money Principles from Hadith!
videos.summary: More money will never cure your financial anxiety—without the right mindset, accumulating more wealth only gives you more to lose and worry about. Grounded in timeless Hadith traditions, this video unpacks 10 transformative principles that dismantle scarcity mindsets and prove that what is destined for you will never miss you. If you want to replace constant financial stress and toxic comparison with unshakable peace and true abundance, this breakdown is an absolute must-watch.

timestamps.topic: Why wealth increases anxiety and where real financial security comes from
The decreed sustenance principle: Why compromising your ethics for money is pointless
Redefining true richness as peace of soul rather than material accumulation

videos.title: Principles of Islamic Banking and Finance - Key Concepts & Applications | AIMS Education
videos.summary: Conventional banking often traps borrowers by placing the entire burden of debt on their shoulders, but Islamic finance flips the script by requiring financiers to become genuine risk-sharing partners. By eliminating exploitative interest (riba) and hidden ambiguity (gharar), this framework proves that financial growth can be both resilient and socially just. Watch this essential primer to discover how aligning your financial decisions with these core principles protects your wealth while serving the greater good.

timestamps.topic: Profit-and-loss sharing and collective risk distribution
The ethical prohibition of interest (riba) and ambiguity (gharar)
Balancing wealth distribution and social impact through zakat

videos.title: Why Bigger Context Windows Won't Save Your Agent — Elizabeth Fuentes Leone, AWS
videos.summary: Think expanding context windows will magically fix your AI agent's memory? In reality, dumping raw logs and tool outputs directly into prompts triggers the 'attention U-curve,' blinding models to middle context and sparking costly hallucinations. This talk reveals practical context engineering architectures—such as offloading heavy data into persistent memory pointers and enforcing tool execution caps—that keep your autonomous agents focused, reliable, and cheap to run.

timestamps.topic: Why 'Infinite Context' Is a Myth and How Attention Degrades
Using Memory Pointers to Prevent Context Window Bloat
Eliminating Infinite Agent Loops with Hard Tool Call Caps

videos.title: AI Hackers Are Faster Than Your Pen Test — Eli Cohen, Snyk
videos.summary: AI coding assistants may be supercharging software delivery, but with over 60% of LLM-generated code harboring flaws and automated attackers breaching systems in as little as four minutes, traditional annual penetration testing is dangerously obsolete. In this eye-opening talk, Snyk Founding Field CTO Elie demonstrates why modern engineering teams must deploy autonomous offensive AI agents to continuously probe, validate, and fix business logic vulnerabilities on every single pull request. Watch this breakdown to discover how multi-agent security architectures can defend your production systems before frontier models weaponize your blind spots.

timestamps.topic: The AI Threat Surge: Insecure Generated Code vs. 4-Minute Automated Breaches
Why Static Scanners and Annual Pen Tests Fail to Catch Business Logic Flaws
The Multi-Agent AI Defense Architecture: Recon, Exploitation, and the Validation 'Judge'

videos.title: The Software Factory: From Bug Report to Production Code — Davis Palmie, Factory
videos.summary: Writing code was never the real bottleneck in software development—the true time sink is stale documentation, manual PR reviews, and fragmented team communications. In this compelling talk, Factory's Davis Polmi reveals how engineering is evolving into an autonomous 'software factory' where AI agents transform incoming bug signals directly into production code while humans act as strategic governors. If you want to stop burning budgets on superficial AI autocomplete and learn the exact blueprint to make your codebase agent-ready, this video is an essential watch.

timestamps.topic: Why coding was never the bottleneck and what a Software Factory does
The 8 pillars of agent readiness: Preparing your codebase for AI
The token vanity trap: Why Goodhart's Law breaks enterprise AI budgets

videos.title: "Clean Code", Horrible Performance | Casey Muratori
videos.summary: Popular software dogma insists that microscopic functions and heavy abstraction make code maintainable, but veteran programmer Casey Muratori exposes the hidden trap: these rules blind compilers from vital optimizations like inlining and SIMD vectorization, cratering your program's performance. He dismantles the widespread misuse of 'premature optimization' as an excuse for architectural neglect, showing how ignoring trade-offs paints engineers into unfixable corners. If you want to write elegant software that doesn't crawl to a halt in production, this candid breakdown will permanently upgrade how you architect code.

timestamps.topic: How 'Clean Code' dogmas blind the compiler to performance optimizations
The danger of treating performance as an afterthought instead of a deliberate trade-off
Hardware awareness: The high-ROI skill that prevents costly rewrites

videos.title: #117 | Can Malaysia Afford AI? (Leon Jala)
videos.summary: While the world celebrates the AI revolution, massive data center expansions are quietly threatening national power grids—with projections showing they could consume up to 31% of Malaysia's electricity by 2035. This breakdown reveals the counter-intuitive 'Jevons Paradox' behind AI energy demand and demonstrates how nations can turn an impending power crisis into a self-funding flywheel for renewable infrastructure. Watch this video to uncover the real physical bottleneck of the AI boom and see why smart energy stewardship will decide which economies truly win the tech race.

timestamps.topic: The Jevons Paradox: Why efficient AI models will actually spike aggregate energy demand
The CRES Framework: Turning massive corporate power demand into a renewable infrastructure flywheel
Strategic Stewardship: Measuring AI investment by lasting productive capacity, not just headline billions

videos.summary: How could the Prophet ﷺ instruct believers to fight to the death to defend their property in one situation, yet command them to smash their swords and refuse to retaliate in another? Dr. Omar Suleiman resolves this striking prophetic paradox, revealing why standing firm against blatant tyranny prevents injustice from becoming normalized, while confusing factional strife (*fitnah*) demands total disarmament to protect your soul. In an age where automated warfare and desensitized news cycles have made human life feel expendable, this talk delivers an urgent moral compass for navigating global chaos with unwavering spiritual integrity.

timestamps.topic: The prophecy of blind killing (Harj) and modern desensitization to mass death
The paradox of resistance: Dying as a martyr vs. shattering your own weapons
Resolving the contradiction: Resisting oppression vs. choosing disarmament in fitnah

Microservices pioneer Sam Newman unpacks the brutal ground truths of resilient engineering, from the three core physical laws behind almost every major production crash to the rising danger of 'cognitive surrender' when letting AI write your code. If you want to stop firefighting unpredictable outages and master how real-world systems actually survive failure, this conversation is essential viewing.

timestamps.topic: Why microservices are an architecture of last resort
The three unbreakable rules of distributed systems
